annotations.title: Room trim plan: every piece, its ends and the stock

description: Plans trim round a room, piece by piece, from its corners, door openings and built-ins (or a drawn room): each piece in fitting order with its long and short point lengths, each end's cope, mitre, butt or scarf with its saw settings, the cut list and the trim lengths to buy.

buildUp.description: Plaster built up in the corners. Left out, none.

casing.description: The door casing's width a skirting butts to beside a door. Left out, none (it butts to the opening's edge).

corners.description: corners[i] is at the end of walls[i], where it meets the next wall (one per wall; the last closes the room).

depth.description: The trim's depth across the joint (skirting thickness, crown projection). Left out, 18 mm (3/4 in) or 75 mm (3 in) for crown.

detail.description: full (the default): the whole answer. summary: the result lines, the citation line and the page only — fewer tokens to read.

direction.description: cw (the default): facing each wall from the room, working left to right. ccw: the canvas's order.

drawing.description: In place of walls and corners: a Construction Canvas drawing in any form the drawing tool takes ({ document }, { commands }, { template }, { house }, { shapes }, { layout }); the room's inside faces, corners and doors are read from it as the canvas's Trim plan reads them.

inputUnits.description: Send "base" to pass bare numbers on dimensioned inputs in base units (m, m², L, kg …), as the published test vectors are written. Without it a length, area or volume must carry its unit.

insideJoint.description: Inside corners coped (the default) or mitred.

kerf.description: The saw's kerf. Left out, 3 mm (1/8 in).

method.description: How the piece goes on the saw: skirting and casing upright (against the fence) or flat (on the table); crown nested (upside down against the fence) or flat. Left out, the trim's usual one.

minOffcut.description: Offcuts at least this long are kept.

room.description: With drawing: the room's id (R1 …). Left out, the drawing's only room.

saw.description: The saw profile the room plan's settings are read on (as the plan on the page): a mitre saw that tilts both ways (the default), one that tilts left only, or a mitre box with 90° at square.

spring.description: Crown only: its spring angle from the wall, degrees (38 for 38/52, 45 for 45/45). Left out, 38.

start.description: The wall fitted first (index). Left out, 0.

stock.description: The stock lengths on offer, with units. Left out, the market's usual trim lengths.

first.description: The first stud's centre from each wall's LEFT corner as you face it.

system.description: The unit system inputs left out open in, and the one the page link opens in. The answer comes in both.

walls.description: The walls in order round the room, up to 40, each with its length along the wall face (corner to corner).

length.description: Along the wall face, corner to corner.

fullHeight.description: A built-in that runs to the ceiling: crown and picture rail stop at it too.

start.description: From the wall's start corner to the near side of the clear opening.
